summary: A compact independent bookstore in Nimman focused on art, design and imported books, with a small café area described by visitors. It works best as an unhurried browse or a rainy-day pause while exploring Nimman, not as a major standalone attraction. The operator currently lists two Chiang Mai branches; this brief covers Nimman Soi 5.
whyGo: Browse a curated selection of art, design, photography and other imported books.
Take a quiet break from Nimman's café and shopping circuit; visitor descriptions mention a small seating/café corner.
Pick up a distinctive book or stationery item if you want a practical, locally sourced souvenir.
bestFor: Readers and design, art or photography enthusiasts
Visitors already spending time around Nimman
A short indoor stop between meals or shops
skipIf: You are looking for a large museum, guided experience or a full-day attraction.
You need a particular title in stock; contact the shop before making a special trip.
You need confirmed step-free access or accessible facilities; these details are not published in the sources checked.
duration: Allow 30–60 minutes for browsing; longer if you settle in with a drink or are choosing a book.
cost: No admission charge is listed; browsing is a normal retail visit. Books and any café purchases are extra, with prices depending on the item. No current branch café menu or typical spend was verified.
hours: The official contact page lists Nimman Soi 5 as open daily: Monday–Thursday 09:00–19:00 and Friday–Sunday 09:00–20:00. Verify around public holidays and before travelling, as December exceptions are not stated.
bestTime: Weekday morning or early afternoon for a quieter browse, based on visitor reports rather than a published crowd forecast. Check the current schedule before setting out.
gettingThere: The operator identifies the branch as Nimmanahaeminda Soi 5. Address listings place it at 5/7 Nimmana Haeminda Road Lane 5, Su Thep. Walk from nearby Nimman businesses or use a local taxi/ride-hail and specify the Soi 5 shop; Chiang Mai has no urban rail service. Parking was mentioned in a 2023 visitor post but should be confirmed locally.
booking: No booking is advertised for browsing; walk-in is the practical assumption. For a specific title or stock question, the official site asks customers to contact the shop at 093-546-3790 or booksmith@smithproject.co.th.
accessibility: Step-free entry, lift access, accessible toilet and seating arrangements were not verified. One visitor account describes a two-storey shop, so ask the branch directly if stairs would be a barrier.
practicalTips: Use the Nimman Soi 5 branch listing, not the separate Chiang Mai Airport branch.
If you are hunting for a particular book, contact the shop first; the operator specifically directs stock questions to local bookshops.
Treat the café seating and refreshments as visitor-reported rather than guaranteed; ask in store about current service and whether a purchase is expected for seating.
Check holiday hours shortly before your visit.
decemberNotes: A flexible indoor stop for a hot or rainy afternoon during Chiang Mai's busy cool season. No December 2026 event, special opening schedule or seasonal promotion was found. Confirm holiday hours and stock close to the date, especially around Christmas and New Year.
uncertainties: The operator's contact page is the strongest current source for hours, but December holiday exceptions are unknown.
Café availability, menu, seating policy, exact book selection and prices may change; visitor descriptions are older and are not an operator guarantee.
Accessibility details and parking availability were not confirmed.
The selected interior image comes from a visitor post dated August 2023; it is representative of the shop as pictured, not a current-condition guarantee. Reuse permission is not established.
